title: 第19章 好人有好报第20章 替身纸人
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
这是月柔媚身上最宝贵的东西了，她不知道该怎么答谢张三恩情，又想自己天赋太低，这个宝物留在自己手中也发挥不出多大作用来。
而且要不是张三相助，此物恐怕也会被夺走，所以在一番心理斗争后，最终她决定将此物送给张三以表谢意。
“嗯……这东西……”
张三沉吟一会儿后，看着月柔媚那碧蓝的双眼确认道：
“送我是吧？”
“嗯。”
柔媚笃定的点了点头。
“行，我收下了。”
说罢，张三就伸手在柔媚那柔顺的头发上摸了摸。
“诶？”
感觉头发上又多了什么的月柔媚碰了碰刚刚张三摸过的地方，发现那里有个熟悉的硬物，分明就是自己刚刚塞进张三手中发卡。
“你怎么……”
“你都说送给我了，那我怎么处理是我自己的事吧？”
张三微微一笑，再次伸手拍了拍月柔媚的小脑瓜，顺便掐了掐她头顶竖着的那两只猫耳。
“这是个好东西，我所以想送给配得上它的一个漂亮可爱的小丫头，你有什么意见吗？”
“额？这……”
得到夸赞的柔媚俏脸一红，她怯生生的说道：
“可是这样我该怎么谢你……”
“我收到了你的心意就足够了。”
张三不会接受柔媚的礼物。

在他看来，自己对柔媚的帮助真就是举手之劳，不值得对方给予这样贵重的犒赏，尤其是这个发卡对这个女孩恐怕还有很多其他意义。
况且这种道具落在具有系统的张三的手里，也就是锦上添花罢了。
可对于这个女孩来说，这可能是她身上最为宝贵的东西。
对方将之送给自己这个刚认识没多久，甚至马上就要分别的“过客”，这份知恩图报的心意让张三颇为动容。
何况人们总是这样，陌生人但凡对自己有一点好，就会将之放大。
所以在张三看来这是柔媚的冲动之举，他不认为自己真的值得对方给予自己这样的感谢，故而将此物归还给了这个女孩。
“嗯？”
耳边传来了更为嘈杂的声音，张三抬头看了一眼人群，原来那名替补的车夫终于来了，其他孩子们已经在接待员的引导下登上马车了。
于是张三又轻轻拍了拍这个有些失落的女孩的小脑瓜，然后提起两边的行李说道：
“该出发了，走吧！”
“呃嗯。”
柔媚紧跟着张三脚步，在张三和一名接待员的帮助下放好行李，找好座位。
“再见！”
在马车即将开动时，张三离开了马车，然后向马车上的柔媚挥手道别。
“再见！”
柔媚也向张三挥手，直到再也看不见张三了，才停下来。
“嘿！柔媚，刚刚那个男孩……诶？你手怎么受伤了？”
content_en:
This is the most precious thing in Yue Roumei's body. She doesn't know how to repay Zhang San's kindness, and she also thinks that her talent is too low, so this treasure will not be of much use in her hands.
And if it hadn't been for Zhang San's help, this thing would probably have been taken away, so after some psychological struggle, she finally decided to give this thing to Zhang San to express her gratitude.
"Well...this thing..."
After Zhang San pondered for a while, he looked at Yue Roumei's blue eyes and confirmed:
"Send it to me, right?"
"Yeah."
Roumei nodded firmly.
"Okay, I'll take it."
After saying that, Zhang San reached out and touched Roumei's smooth hair.
"Eh?"
Yue Roumei, who felt that there was something extra in her hair, touched the place where Zhang San had just touched, and found a familiar hard object there, which was clearly the hairpin she had just inserted into Zhang San's hand.
"How did you..."
"You said you gave it to me, so what I do with it is my own business, right?"
Zhang San smiled slightly, reached out and patted Yue Roumei's little head again, and pinched the two cat ears standing up on her head.
"This is a good thing, so I want to give it to a beautiful and cute little girl who deserves it. Do you have any opinions?"
"Uh? This..."
Roumei's pretty face blushed when she received the compliment, and she said timidly:
"But how can I thank you like this..."
"It's enough that I received your heart."
Zhang San will not accept soft gifts.
In his opinion, his help to Roumei was just a small effort and not worthy of such a precious reward, especially since this hairpin may have many other meanings to this girl.
Moreover, it is just the icing on the cake that this kind of prop falls into the hands of the systematic Zhang San.
But for this girl, this may be the most precious thing in her body.
The other party gave it to him as a "passer-by" whom he had just met and was about to say goodbye. Zhang San was quite moved by this kindness and repayment.
What's more, people are always like this. Whenever strangers are kind to themselves, they will magnify it.
Therefore, in Zhang San's opinion, this was a soft and impulsive move. He did not think that he really deserved such gratitude from the other party, so he returned the object to the girl.
"Huh?"
Hearing more noisy sounds, Zhang San raised his head and glanced at the crowd. It turned out that the substitute coachman had finally arrived, and the other children had already boarded the carriage under the guidance of the receptionist.
So Zhang San gently patted the little girl who was a little disappointed again, then picked up the luggage on both sides and said:
"It's time to go, let's go!"
"Uh-huh."
Roumei followed Zhang San closely, put down her luggage and found a seat with the help of Zhang San and a receptionist.
"Goodbye!"
When the carriage was about to start, Zhang San left the carriage, and then waved goodbye to Roumei on the carriage.
"Goodbye!"
Roumei also waved to Zhang San, and did not stop until she could no longer see Zhang San.
"Hey! Roumei, that boy just now...eh? Why did your hand get hurt?"
